name: Shortcut
description: Shortcut is a project management tool designed to help teams plan, collaborate, and track their work efficiently. It offers features like task management, workflow automation, and team collaboration to streamline project execution.

events.d: Create a story with title and workflow state. Optionally add description, owners, labels, tasks, deadline, custom fields.
Find stories in your Shortcut workspace using a text query or filters.
Create a category in Shortcut.

events.n: When a new category is created
events.d: Runs the workflow automatically whenever a new category is created in the account.
Create a new label and set its name, optional description, color, and external ID.
Create a new epic in a Shortcut project.

events.n: When a new epic is created
events.d: Runs the workflow automatically whenever a new epic is created in the account.
Gets a list of all categories and their attributes in Shortcut.
Show details for a selected Shortcut category.
List all objectives in a specified category.
Get information about a specific entity template.
Get all epics and their details.
Fetch details for a selected Epic; optionally return only chosen fields.
Get all iterations in the workspace.
Retrieve all labels in the workspace. Optionally return slim results using the slim parameter.
Retrieve all linked files in the workspace and their attributes, optionally returning only selected fields.
Get members in the workspace. Optionally filter by disabled status and return only selected member fields.
Retrieve all objectives and optionally select which fields to return.
Show workflows in your workspace.
Update a story's details, title, description, workflow state, estimate, assignees, labels, deadline, or custom fields.
Add a comment to a story; optionally set author, parent comment, external ID, or timestamps.
Update an Epic's title, description, state, labels, owners, dates, or other fields.
Create a task inside a story and set description, completion, owners, external ID, and created/updated dates.

events.n: Add a Comment to an Epic
events.d: Post a comment on an epic to share updates, feedback, or context.
Update a label's name, color, description, or archived status.
Create a document with a title and content; optionally assign it to a project and set its visibility.
Create an objective to set and track project or team goals.
Edit an Objective's title, description, or other details.

events.n: When a new iteration is created
events.d: Runs the workflow automatically whenever a new iteration is created in the account.
Create an iteration (sprint) with a name and start/end dates; optionally add description, teams, followers and labels.
Update an existing iteration's details, such as its name, start and end dates, or workflow settings.
